fusions.name: Drove-Road Tread
fusions.desc: Stamps shod hooves down round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Lead Ox
fusions.desc: A horn-first blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoked Together
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
